selection: minimum summed training loss; ties choose the shortest cooldown
limits: Public fixtures are predeclared, not blinded or empirical.
The clock, arrivals, storage sensors, process durations and failures are simulated.
The existing controller and SQLite transitions execute locally; no mission subprocess runs.
Only the cooldown parameter is selected from training. No online threshold learning is installed.
The simulator excludes authentication, registration and daily quotas, backup health, CPU and network.
The loss is an explicit synthetic proxy, not money, wellbeing or probability of sustained life.
Even eligibility only permits review; deployment and real-traffic validation remain separate.
